reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual second-round review of external-02 against the exact native source, enlarged source page 10 and targeted source-note crop, complete unchanged full native RGBA raw, targeted native-resolution returned-note crop, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference; earlier review files were left unchanged

remaining_reasons: The returned note still has three distinct upper gray-mark rows. The source has its original compact two-row footprint, and this round explicitly forbids a third row. Remove the third row and retain only the source-scale two compact rows while preserving the repaired strict profile and absence of a pin.
entries.positive_observation: External-02 successfully restores the strict left-facing profile: only one eye is visible, the nose/mouth point left, and the prior second eye is gone. The circular pin/seal is also removed. The high bald crown, short dark side/back hair, one dark visible eyebrow and absence of a beard or clearly added eyewear remain. The dark olive uniform retains gold shoulder braid, pale metallic collar patches, one dark-bordered pale neck cross and a compact cluster of breast decorations. The rounded lower head meets a short broad high collar. The complete dark tilted frame, opaque pale warm grey-beige backing, cream note and right-edge tab remain, and full white/cyan comparisons show no visible holes, lost backing or working-matte ring. The remaining third note row is the rejection reason.
entries.visible_limitations: A possible tiny eyewear/temple detail, individual breast decorations, collar symbols and note lettering are unresolved at source scale; none is an additional rejection reason. The repaired one-eye profile and remaining three note rows are directly visible in native images.
